text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out on an outing with Yaeno Muteki, 
we ran into Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Bamboo-san. Are you heading out 
somewhere?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"The museum! My mom told me to go check it 
out, and apparently they're holding this 
super rare special exhibition!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What was it again... apparently they're 
exhibiting diaries and essays—or whatever 
they're called—from various eras, sir.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ho... Perhaps there might even be diaries 
of renowned martial artists. Fascinating 
indeed...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up accompanying Bamboo 
Memory to the museum she was heading to.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"—Man, the vibes were great, y'know! All 
the handwriting was all squiggly though, 
so I couldn't really understand what it 
said!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...There was an exhibit that caught my 
eye.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, you were looking 
really closely at someone's diary, right? 
According to the explanation next to it, 
it was about...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—"All of the martial arts felt utterly 
empty." Years of endless battles... 
"emptiness" born from reaching the 
pinnacle of the way. That heartfelt 
sentiment was vividly recorded.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I... know of someone. Someone who has 
reached that very same realm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"She was an Umamusume and my senior 
disciple. One of the foremost talents 
among the master's pupils, she was a 
master pugilist licensed in the full 
traditions at a young age."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
A bold yet kind-hearted figure, and above 
all, devoted wholeheartedly to mastering 
the martial arts. Many disciples, myself 
included, deeply admired that about them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My senior disciple changed after... she 
took part in a tournament called the 
'Heaven and Earth Strongest Tournament.'

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Senior Disciple
text_block_list.text:
—In that final, I threw "everything" I had 
at her. Everything nurtured at the 
Yaegaki, against someone who fought her 
way up after beating the world's 
strongest.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Senior Disciple
text_block_list.text:
I had a truly wonderful time. In the prime 
of my physical strength, I got to have the 
best battle with the best opponent.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Senior Disciple
text_block_list.text:
...Makes sense, I guess. That everything 
felt so empty after that, no matter what I 
did. In my life... there's nothing 'beyond 
that' anymore.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—After that, they fled the Kongo Yaegaki 
style. To this day, their whereabouts 
remain unknown.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...The path of self-improvement is 
supposed to be endless. Yet... what if, 
like my senior apprentice, I were to see 
the "end of the road"?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What... should I do?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. Yaeno, got a minute?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have changed as instructed, but... 
Bamboo-san, what are we going to do now?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "That's obvious! —We run!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what, I'm gonna overtake you! 
This is an all-out, no-holds-barred 
showdown, let's goooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san...!? Kuh, please wait!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, what's wrong?! Is that all 
you've got?! I won't let you off if you 
lose without giving it your all!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! Not yet! Let me show you... the 
true strength of Yaegaki!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno & Bamboo
text_block_list.text: —Uooooooh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...! Bamboo-san, it looks like 
your skills have improved yet again...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Heheh. Listen up, Yaeno. Let me just say 
this one thing.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Even if Yaeno ends up seeing 'the end'... 
us rivals will definitely pass you right 
back! We won't leave you any time to feel 
empty!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then Yaeno will get waay stronger! And 
we'll get waaay stronger, too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Then everything's totally fine, right! 
There's nothing to mope about at all!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bamboo-san...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. I truly am... blessed with 
wonderful people around me."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A formidable rival... What a 
wonderful word that is.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Now, looking back, I can't help but 
wonder. If my senior disciple had also 
felt the way I do now..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki looked up at the sky with a 
clear, resolved expression. Yet in that 
look, there also seemed to linger a touch 
of loneliness.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... If I can prove myself worthy as 
a formidable rival to my senior disciple."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—No, I shall become one. Not just in terms 
of "strength," but to reach a level where 
I can truly empathize with that person's 
anguish!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To welcome that day... I will continue to 
devote myself to my training! Osu!!
